fusions.name: Vambrace Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a knife from your vambrace that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at 6 tiles.

fusions.name: Slit and Strike
fusions.desc: Throws a knife through the gap in the first enemy's helm, dealing 12 damage and stunning it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Spurred Plate
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Between the Seams
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
